summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by OceanaGold Corp to re-file audited consolidated financial statements for the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, correcting an inadvertent omission of auditor reports from a prior filing. The filing includes independent auditor reports from PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP (Canada) and PricewaterhouseCoopers (Australia), and incorporates the exhibits by reference into existing registration statements on Form S-8 and Form 40-F. There are no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic changes. This is a routine corrective filing of financial statements and audit opinions.
